spec.text: Image 1 is the couple in their registration-day outfits; image 2 is a real photo of Four Four South Village with Taipei 101; image 3 is a real photo of the village houses' colorful doors and windows; image 4 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). A bright sunny day with deep blue sky and white clouds, back at Four Four South Village: in front of the old grey village houses with colorful green, blue and red doors and windows from images 2 and 3, Taipei 101 towering behind, the couple in their registration-day outfits hold up their marriage certificate together with their inner hands, beaming, the certificate facing away from the camera; in her OTHER hand the woman clearly holds her small blush and cream bouquet, exactly as in image 1. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
